newsitem.title: USA: PP&L to take $0.06/shr charge in Q3.
newsitem.headline: PP&L to take $0.06/shr charge in Q3.

text.p: Power company PP&L Resources Inc said Wednesday it will take a one-time charge of $0.06 a share in the third quarter to cover the transactions costs of its acquisition of Penn Fuel Gas Co.
PP&L said in a statement it could also incur a one-time charge of about $0.24 a share in the same quarter given a budget proposal presented by the new British government.

The country's Labour government has proposed a windfall profits tax on privatized utilities in the United Kingdom, which could affect its wholly-owned subsidiary, Power Markets Development Co, it said.
The subsidiary owns 25 percent of South Western Electricity Plc, and preliminary estimates have put the British company's windfall profits tax at about $160 million.
